SELECT
	--COUNT(*)
     CAST(LE.ID AS varchar(100)) AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER
	,[value] as CUSTOMER_ID
    ,concat('Entity_CIF_CRM_', [value]) as EntityCIF
    ,[value] as FCBSCIF
    ,LE.BNK_CODE as BankCode
    ,NULL as BranchCode
    ,NULL as BranchName
    ,NULL as Area
    ,NULL as Region
	,'TRY' SourceSystemCode
    ,NULL as ProductGrouping
    ,NULL as ProductType
    ,NULL as ProductDetails
	,NULL as OpenedDate
	,COALESCE(SUM(
					(CASE 
					WHEN TRADES.product_type LIKE 'Bond%'
						AND TRADES.book = 'Client'
						AND TRADES.bundle_type <> 'ASSET SWAP'
						AND TRADES.tradestatus = 'VERIFIED'
						AND TRADES.maturity_date > CAST('2024-03-21' AS DATE)
						THEN TRADES.NOMINAL
					WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
						AND TRADES.BOOK IN (
							'F_Intl_MM_Team1'
							,'F_Intl_MM_Team2'
							,'R_Dom_MM_Team1'
							,'R_Dom_MM_Team2'
							,'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing'
							)
						AND TRADES.bundle_type <> 'PYA'
						AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED'
						THEN TRADES.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
					WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
						AND TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA'
						AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED'
						THEN TRADES.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
					WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
						AND TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%'
						AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED'
						THEN TRADES.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
					WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%'
						AND TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP'
						AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED'
						AND TRADES.MATURITY_DATE > CAST('2024-03-21' AS DATE)
						THEN TRADES.NOMINAL
					END)
					* Rate.ConversionRate
				)
		 ,0) as OutstandingInvestmentFull
    ,NULL as OutstandingInvestmentProrated
    ,CAST('2024-03-21' AS DATE) as BusinessDate
    ,CAST('2024-03-21' AS DATE) as LastUpdatedDate -- I think this one is system-generated. Kindly fill correct field.
    ,concat(CAST(LE.ID AS varchar(100)), [value], LE.BNK_CODE, 'TRY') as AccountKey
FROM eds.TRY_LEGALENTITY AS LE --58328
CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF, '|')
LEFT JOIN eds.TRY_TRADES TRADES --36403
	ON LE.ID = TRADES.COUNTERPARTY_ID
	AND CAST('2024-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN TRADES.SCD_START_DATE
		AND TRADES.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01') Rate
	ON CAST('2024-03-21' AS DATE) = CAST(Rate.CurrencyConversionTimestamp AS DATE) AND TRADES.TRADE_CURRENCY = Rate.ConvertFromCurrencyId
WHERE TRADES.CounterParty_ID IS NOT NULL
	AND CAST('2024-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN LE.SCD_START_DATE AND LE.SCD_END_DATE
	AND LE.STATUS = 'ENABLED'
	AND LE.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
    --AND left([value], 1) = 'R'
GROUP BY
     CAST(LE.ID AS varchar(100))
	,[value]
    ,LE.BNK_CODE
